titles.title: MANNARINO Act
MANNARINO Act
Mitigating Abuse of Nitrous-oxide Nationwide And Reducing Inhalation-related Neurological Outcomes Act

To amend the Public Health Service Act to require States to prohibit the sale of certain products containing nitrous oxide as a condition on receipt of block grants for community mental health services, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
